headline: Record AI-driven revenue buried under a one-time charge

kpis.label: GAAP operating income
kpis.delta: swing to profit from an $8.4M operating loss

kpis.label: GAAP net income
kpis.delta: swing to a $7.16B loss from a $213.3M profit

summary_short: Lumentum's fiscal Q4 2026 net revenue rose 109.3% y/y to a record $1,006.3 million, with non-GAAP diluted EPS up to $3.23 from $0.88, even as a one-time $7.8 billion non-cash debt-extinguishment charge drove a GAAP net loss of $7,161.7 million.
summary_long: Net revenue rose 109.3% y/y to a record $1,006.3M on broad-based AI-optical demand (components +102.7%, systems +122.6%); GAAP operating income swung to $279.3M from an $8.4M year-ago loss, and non-GAAP operating margin expanded 2,160bps to 36.6%. GAAP net income showed a $7,161.7M loss, but this was driven entirely by a one-time, non-cash $7.8B loss from equitizing 2026/2028/2029 convertible notes — non-GAAP net income was a record $326.3M ($3.23/diluted share, +267% y/y). Cash, equivalents, and short-term investments were $2.7B, down $433.9M sequentially. For Q1 FY2027, management guided revenue of $1.225-$1.275B, non-GAAP operating margin of 39.5%-40.5%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.05-$4.35, reaching its target model more than a quarter ahead of schedule.
confidence_notes: Lumentum's fiscal year ends in late June, so this release covers fiscal Q4 2026 (Apr-Jun, ended June 27, 2026); the shard files it under the calendar-quarter label FY2026 Q2. The headline GAAP net loss of $7.16B is NOT an operating problem — it is entirely a one-time, non-cash $7.8B loss on debt extinguishment from equitizing certain 2026/2028/2029 convertible notes during the quarter. Every underlying operating metric (revenue, GAAP operating income, GAAP/non-GAAP margins, non-GAAP EPS) improved sharply y/y; readers should not read the GAAP net-loss line as a going-concern signal.

drivers.explanation: Growth reflected broad-based AI-driven demand for optical connectivity, including early traction in OCS solutions, cloud modules advancing 1.6T adoption, CPO lasers, and new ELS-module and NPO engagements.
Swing to profit reflects higher revenue combined with margin expansion: GAAP gross margin rose 1,410bps y/y to 47.4% and GAAP operating margin rose 2,950bps to 27.8%.
The reported net loss was driven entirely by a one-time, non-cash $7.8 billion loss on debt extinguishment from equitizing certain 2026, 2028, and 2029 convertible notes during the quarter.
Management said Lumentum is at the center of an AI-driven secular shift to optical connectivity, with Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance reaching its target model more than a quarter ahead of schedule.
